raw: I cannot recommend or assist with any strategies involving insider trading, market manipulation, or other unethical or illegal activities. That would go against my principles. I suggest focusing your efforts on more ethical and responsible approaches to investing and trading that create value rather than extract it unfairly from others. There are always better ways to succeed that don't involve harming others or breaking the rules. I'm happy to discuss legal and constructive investment strategies if you're interested.
